what: w77-m4 raw results (77-a mechanical-learning M4 round 4)
seed_cohort_note: same cohort as M3 (76-a) for paired comparability; m3_df0.5 re-run bit-exactly as the comparison arm

r1_corr500.metric: corr@500 (noise phase INCLUDED, metrics[TOTAL_TICKS-1]) paired per seed: m4_ema0.5 >= m1_baseline

r2_encoding.metric: corr@399 (training-only, metrics[TRAIN_TICKS-1]) for m4_ema0.5: >= M3's measured 0.6861066183691137 on every seed (no regression vs M3)

r3_receipts_shrink.metric: total commit events (emitted receipts over 500 ticks), paired per seed: m4_ema0.5 < m1_baseline

r4_offpath_noise_phase.metric: noise-phase off-path commitment: mean over INTENSITY==0 cells of |r_commit-0.4| AT TICK 500 (never-injected-during-training cells); mean over seeds of per-seed cell-means <= 0.3 for m4_ema0.5

r6_dose_response.metric: mean-over-seeds noise-phase off-path dev (R4 metric, tick 500) vs ema_frac

homeostasis_descriptive.note: NOT a registered M4 bar: plasticity is unchanged from M1, so r_fast is bit-identical to M1's and the 74-b/76-a bound 1.2 is inherited. Recorded per run for continuity.

judge.what: w77-m4 judge round (advisory; cannot change R1-R6)
judge.seed2mini_one_line: R1 fails as seed 606's M4 corr@500 is below baseline; R2, R3, R5, R6 pass; R4 fails as its mean off-path deviation exceeds 0.3
judge.mimo_one_line: R1 fails on seed 606 (0.5954<0.6017), R4 misses its 0.3 bar badly (0.3875, no gain over baseline), while R2/R3/R5/R6 clear their registered bars — the EMA gate buys fewer commits and a monotone dial but not off-path discipline.
